description: The plot illustrates how a metric labeled “Similarity” varies across model “Layer” indices for four language-pair conditions (en&en, en&es, en&el, en&bn). The x-axis is labeled “Layer,” uses a linear scale, and spans integer layers from 0 to 23 with tick labels shown every 2 layers (0, 2, 4, …, 22). The y-axis is labeled “Similarity,” uses a linear scale, and ranges from 0.00 up to 0.45 with regularly spaced tick labels at 0.05 intervals. Four solid lines without markers are shown: the dark red line (en&en) starts near 0.07 at layer 0, rises to a local peak around 0.26 at layer 6, drops to about 0.16 at layer 7, stays around ~0.16–0.18 through roughly layers 8–13, declines to about 0.12–0.13 around layers 15–16, reaches a low near ~0.08 around layers 19–21, then increases sharply to about 0.18 at layer 22 and ends near 0.43 at layer 23; the blue line (en&es) begins near 0.06 at layer 0, increases to about 0.24 at layer 6, drops to about 0.15 at layer 7, remains around ~0.15–0.18 through about layers 8–13, declines to roughly ~0.11–0.12 by layers 15–16, falls further to around ~0.06 by layers 19–21, then rises to about 0.12 at layer 22 and ends near 0.27 at layer 23; the green line (en&el) starts near 0.045 at layer 0, rises to about 0.15 at layer 6, drops to about 0.10 at layer 7, gradually increases to around ~0.14–0.15 by about layers 12–13, declines to roughly ~0.09 by layers 15–16, reaches around ~0.05 near layers 19–21, then increases to about 0.11 at layer 22 and ends near 0.30 at layer 23; the magenta line (en&bn) begins near 0.035 at layer 0, rises to about 0.14 at layer 6, drops to about 0.095 at layer 7, increases to around ~0.13–0.14 by about layers 12–13, declines to roughly ~0.085–0.09 by layers 15–16, reaches around ~0.055 near layers 19–21, then rises to about 0.13 at layer 22 and ends near 0.29 at layer 23.
